question_text: How are PFAS samples preconcentrated before mass spectrometry, and how do protocols vary by matrix, analyte, or method?

question_components.description: Identify how PFAS samples are preconcentrated prior to mass spectrometric analysis, including specific preconcentration techniques and procedural steps
Describe how preconcentration protocols for PFAS vary with sample matrix (e.g., different water types, complex matrices)
Describe how preconcentration protocols for PFAS vary with analyte properties or PFAS subclasses
Describe how preconcentration protocols for PFAS vary with the analytical method or instrumentation used for mass spectrometry

question_text: What chain-length-related differences in PFAS analytical sensitivity or LOD/LOQ have been reported, and how do method or instrument settings affect them?

question_components.description: Reported differences in analytical sensitivity, including LOD and LOQ, among PFAS of different chain lengths
Influence of analytical method type, sample preparation, or instrument settings on any chain-length-related differences in PFAS sensitivity or LOD/LOQ

question_text: How do electrolyte composition and pH-control choices affect interpretation of PFAS removal or degradation experiments?

question_components.description: How local and bulk pH conditions, and choices about pH control or monitoring, influence PFAS electrochemical degradation/removal behavior and the interpretation of experimental results

How electrolyte identity, concentration, and composition (including background matrices and ion valency) influence PFAS removal/degradation performance and the interpretation or comparability of experiments
Methodological or interpretive cautions, artifacts, or limitations related to pH and electrolyte conditions that can lead to misinterpretation of PFAS removal or degradation experiments

question_text: What energy-consumption or energy-efficiency evidence is available for PFAS degradation methods, and can values be compared across studies?

question_components.description: Identify reported energy-consumption or energy-efficiency metrics for PFAS degradation or destruction methods, including how they are defined and quantified (e.g., EE/O, kWh per volume, mg removed per kWh, energy per defluorination).

Determine whether and how energy-consumption or energy-efficiency values for PFAS degradation methods can be compared across studies, including any use of standardized metrics, normalization approaches, or stated comparability/limitations.

question_text: How do reported activated-carbon PFAS adsorption capacities differ between batch and column studies?

question_components.description: Identify and compare reported PFAS adsorption capacities of activated carbon measured in batch studies versus column studies, including how capacities differ in magnitude, trends, or interpretation between these two experimental modes.

question_text: What membrane-based PFAS treatment routes are described, and which routes separate or concentrate PFAS rather than destroy or transform them?

question_components.description: Identify the membrane-based PFAS treatment routes described in the literature, including types of membrane processes and how they are used for PFAS remediation.
Determine which of the described membrane-based PFAS treatment routes primarily separate or concentrate PFAS into a secondary stream rather than destroy or transform the PFAS molecules.

question_text: When comparing membrane filtration, gliding arc plasma, and supercritical water oxidation for PFAS treatment, which reported endpoints should be kept separate?

question_components.description: Identify and distinguish the types of reported endpoints used to evaluate membrane filtration for PFAS treatment, including whether they reflect separation/concentration versus destruction or mineralization
Identify and distinguish the types of reported endpoints used to evaluate gliding arc plasma treatment of PFAS, including degradation, mineralization, defluorination, or related measures
Identify and distinguish the types of reported endpoints used to evaluate supercritical water oxidation (SCWO) of PFAS, including destruction, mineralization, defluorination, or related measures

Determine which endpoint types differ in nature across membrane filtration, gliding arc plasma, and SCWO and therefore should not be directly compared or conflated when assessing PFAS treatment performance

question_text: When screening activated-carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies, what matrix and regeneration gaps should be checked?

question_components.description: Identify which water or environmental matrices (e.g., DI water, groundwater, wastewater, soil effluents, real-world vs synthetic matrices) should be checked or flagged as gaps when screening activated carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies.

Identify what aspects of adsorbent regeneration (e.g., regeneration methods, desorption efficiency, structural stability, number of cycles, destruction vs separation, scale) are commonly missing or limited and should be checked as gaps in activated carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies.

question_text: How should contact time be planned when powder activated carbon is used for both short- and long-chain PFAS?

question_components.description: Identify how contact time affects adsorption/ removal of long-chain PFAS by powder activated carbon and what contact times are needed to reach high removal or equilibrium
Identify how contact time affects adsorption/ removal of short-chain PFAS by powder activated carbon and what contact times are needed to reach high removal or equilibrium
Identify any differences in required contact time between short- and long-chain PFAS when using powder activated carbon and implications for planning contact time

question_text: Under what conditions might supercritical water oxidation leave uncertainty about fluorinated products?

question_components.description: Identify conditions or aspects of supercritical water oxidation under which there may be uncertainty about the nature, fate, or completeness of destruction of fluorinated products or byproducts

question_text: How does PFAS chain length affect reported treatment performance or adsorption behavior?

question_components.description: How PFAS perfluoroalkyl chain length influences adsorption affinity, capacity, or breakthrough behavior across treatment/adsorption systems
How PFAS chain length affects competitive adsorption or selectivity between long- and short-chain PFAS in mixed systems
How PFAS chain length, via hydrophobicity or related properties, mechanistically explains observed treatment or adsorption performance trends

question_text: How can PFAS compound class or headgroup affect treatment performance or equilibrium behavior?

question_components.description: How PFAS headgroup or compound class influences treatment performance (e.g., adsorption, defluorination, removal efficiency) across different treatment technologies
How PFAS headgroup or compound class influences equilibrium behavior (e.g., binding constants, adsorption equilibrium, breakthrough) in treatment systems or sorbent interactions

question_text: Does longer empty-bed contact time necessarily translate into better PFAS performance in granular activated carbon systems?

question_components.description: Determine whether increasing empty-bed contact time (EBCT) in granular activated carbon systems always leads to improved PFAS removal performance or adsorption capacity
